title: Acpilot extension manifest
description: `extension.toml`, the entire interface between an extension and the daemon. It names files and nothing else: there is no install script and no build step, every contribution is parsed by the same reader as a user's own configuration, and a contribution path may not leave the extension directory. The file is TOML — this schema describes it, it does not replace it — and an editor reads it from the `$schema` key or a `#:schema` first line.
$comment: Apache-2.0. Generated from crates/acpilot-extensions/src/manifest.rs by `cargo xtask schema`; edit the Rust, not this file. This is the v1 document and is frozen: a change a `schema_version = 1` loader would read differently ships as extension-v2.json.

Contribution.description: One asset named by the manifest.

kind.description: Which registry the asset lands in.

path.description: Path relative to the extension directory, with forward slashes. `.` and `..` segments are refused by the loader; this pattern cannot state that, so it states the other half — no leading slash, no backslash.

ExtensionKind.description:
What an extension contributes.

One extension may contribute several kinds; a "Rust pack" is a bundle rather
than a category, which is why this is a list on the summary and a single value
on each contribution.

oneOf.description: A colour scheme shared by TUI, GUI, and web.

A prebuilt tree-sitter grammar plus its queries.
A program-as-agent transcript parser. Tier 2; not in v0.1.

version.description: Semantic version. The store keeps versions side by side.

publisher.description: Who published it, matched against the index entry.

homepage.description: Project page, reviewed by a human before the index accepts it.
